dates.description: List of date ranges to calculate spending analysis for. This allows retrieving spending analysis of up to three different date ranges in one request.

name.description: Descriptive name for the date range. The name will be used in the response payload to identify it.

from.description: Start date to perform spending analysis.

to.description: End date to perform spending analysis.

items.description: Account ids to be included in the spending analysis. If none are given the analysis will include all accounts.
Category ids to be included in the spending analysis. If none are given the analysis will include all categories.
Project ids to be included in the spending analysis. If none are given the analysis will include all projects.
